c.st: The Copyright Office Belongs in a Library
c.x: I'm not a huge fan of copyright, but I wholeheartedly disagree with this analysis.  The clause providing for copyright is an Article I, Section 8 clause.  Generally Speaking (except for the post office) the AIS8 duties have legislated details, but execution is left to the executive branch.  For example, the USPTO is part of the department of commerce.  It's not clear as to why the copyright office, which is justified in the same clause that justifies the PTO, shouldn't be part of the executive branch.
